instruction.text: Drag the quadrilaterals into the correct places in the Venn diagram.

hint.label: Venn diagram
hint.text:
The quadrilateral with a pair of parallel sides, but no right angle, goes in the circle on the left.

The quadrilateral with a right angle, but with no pair of parallel sides, goes in the circle on the right.

The quadrilateral with a right angle and a pair of parallel sides goes in the middle.

instruction.text: Drag the quadrilaterals into the correct places in the Venn diagram.

hint.label: Venn diagram
hint.text:
The quadrilateral with four sides with equal lengths and two pairs of parallel sides goes in the middle.

The other two quadrilaterals both have two pairs of parallel sides, but not four sides with equal lengths. This means they both go in the circle on the right.

instruction.text: Drag the quadrilaterals into the correct places in the Venn diagram.

hint.label: Venn diagram
hint.text:
Two quadrilaterals have right angles, but not four equal sides or two pairs of parallel sides. These go in the top right purple section.

The quadrilateral with two pairs of parallel sides, but not four equal sides or a right angle, goes in the bottom blue section.

The quadrilateral with four sides with equal lengths and two pairs of parallel sides, but no right angle, goes in the section between the yellow and blue sections.

The quadrilateral with a right angle and two pairs of parallel sides, but not four sides with equal lengths, goes in the section between the purple and blue sections.

The quadrilateral with 4 sides with equal lengths, a right angle and two pairs of parallel sides goes in the very centre.
